about: Whether a path with no resource. prefix names an attribute of the resource. Every recorded condition reads the resource as resource.<path>, and the agent's own condition parser accepts nothing else; a bare a == 'y' is either the same attribute or a form the PAP refuses. Each case records the upload status and, for an accepted policy, one request the condition holds for and one it does not, so an accepted form that is never evaluated (false under both) is told from one that reads the resource. The case with sets runs on the legacy profile only.
